description: Water-gas shift reactor + physical solvent separation (Selexol/Rectisol) for IGCC pre-combustion CO2 capture.

unit.name: IGCC-type WGS + Selexol separation unit
unit.source: IEAGHG (2014) Report 2012/8; Kunze & Spliethoff (2012) Applied Energy 94:109; DOE/NETL-2010/1397.

T_WGS_opt.note: Optimal WGS temperature (low-T shift catalyst: 200-300 degC, achieves X>0.90)

X_WGS_max.note: Maximum WGS CO conversion (thermodynamic limit at optimal T, excess steam)

k_T_WGS.note: Gaussian width for WGS temperature response

P_ref_WGS.note: Reference WGS operating pressure (IGCC syngas ~20-40 bar)

P_exp_WGS.note: Weak pressure dependence of WGS conversion (equilibrium minimally affected)

eta_sep_design.note: Selexol/Rectisol separation efficiency (captures ~97% of shifted CO2, IEAGHG 2014)

E_sep_base.note: Base separation energy (Selexol at high CO2 partial pressure ~15 bar: ~0.3 GJ/tCO2, Kunze 2012)

k_sep.note: Separation energy sensitivity to CO2 partial pressure

P_ref_sep_bar.note: Reference CO2 partial pressure for separation (high-P IGCC advantage)

E_compression.note: CO2 compression to pipeline pressure (110 bar): ~0.10 GJ/tCO2 (Lozza 2002)

DH_WGS.note: WGS reaction enthalpy (exothermic, -41.1 kJ/mol CO at 250 degC)
